The '''Barkhetta''' was a model of fast, open-cabin [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] that was utilized as a luxury [[EasyRide passenger airspeeder/Legends|air taxi]] on the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="CCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>
